@[simp]
theorem arctan_inv_sqrt_three : arctan (√3)⁻¹ = π / 6 := by
  rw [inv_eq_one_div, ← tan_pi_div_six, arctan_tan]
  all_goals
  · field_simp
    norm_num

example : arctan (√3)⁻¹ = π / 6 := by simp?

example : arctan (1 / √3) = π / 6 := by simp?

example : arctan (√3) = π / 3 := by simp?

example : arctan (tan (π / 6)) = π / 6 := by simp?

example (x : ℝ) : arctan x = π / 3 ↔ x = √3 := by
  rw [← arctan_sqrt_three, arctan_inj]
